# Third-party

- `rcheevos/` — vendored [RetroAchievements/rcheevos](https://github.com/RetroAchievements/rcheevos) (MIT). Already in the tree.
- `mgba/` — created by `../fetch-deps.sh` from [mgba-emu/mgba](https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba) (MPL-2.0).
- `prefix/` — `libmgba.a` + public headers after a successful fetch-deps run.
